import pathlib,json,hashlib,base64
paths=list(pathlib.Path('/tmp').glob('jest_*/perf-cache*'))+list(pathlib.Path('/app/node_modules').glob('**/TestScheduler.js'))+list(pathlib.Path('/app').glob('jest*.js'))+list(pathlib.Path('/app').glob('jest*.json'))
rows=[]
for p in paths:
 b=p.read_bytes()
 if p.name=='TestScheduler.js' and b'_updatePerfCache' not in b:continue
 rows.append({'path':str(p),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'base64':base64.b64encode(b).decode()})
print(json.dumps(rows))
